tesoreria.name: API Tesorería
tesoreria.description:
Optimize corporate liquidity and real-time decision-making. Embed your company's
consolidated cash position directly into your core systems.
tesoreria.heroDescription: Retrieve movements from a corporate account, with currency filters and pagination.
tesoreria.intro: Built for companies that need near real-time financial visibility, this API centralizes the information required to reconcile, forecast cash, and automate back-office processes.
tesoreria.idealFor: Teams that need visible liquidity, faster reconciliation, and automation across internal workflows.

benefits.0: Automate reconciliations and reduce manual steps in your internal processes.
benefits.1: Bring treasury data into ERPs, dashboards, and operational workflows.

useCases.0: Retrieve movements for a corporate account by tax ID (NIT).
useCases.1: Retrieve movements within a date range (fechaInicial and fechaFinal).
useCases.2: Filter movements by currency and paginate the results.

requirements.0: Have an active developer account and approved access to the product.
requirements.1: Hold Sandbox or Production credentials, depending on your integration stage.
requirements.2: Use a secure backend to manage tokens, tracing, and endpoint consumption.

authentication.title: Client credentials and secure headers
authentication.description: The integration requires credentials issued by Davivienda and security headers that identify the application and trace every operation.

movimientos.description: Retrieve movements from a corporate account, with currency filters and pagination.

parameters.nit: Company tax ID (array; more than one value may be accepted)
parameters.fechaInicial: Start date of the query range
parameters.fechaFinal: End date of the query range

400.title: Invalid request
400.description: nit, fechaInicial, fechaFinal, or paginacion is missing, or the date range is invalid.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.description: The access key is invalid, expired, or does not belong to this environment.

500.title: Internal error
500.description: A temporary issue occurred while processing the query. Try again later.

tesoreria.supportNote: If your use case needs additional validations, multi-account coverage, or high corporate volumes, our team will support you through the enablement process.
